weight_vintage.label: UN-WPP-2024
weight_vintage.frequency: low (annual); value uses ECB daily reference FX
weight_vintage.note: SDR-style fixed basket, population version. Quantities are pinned from UN population shares read from the UN Population Division's own WPP 2024 file; value is read from ECB euro reference rates. Same method formulas and the same FX inputs as v0.1-2026-05-15.

population.source: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division (2024). World Population Prospects 2024, Online Edition.
population.publisher: United Nations, Department of Economic and Social Affairs, Population Division
population.field: TPopulation1July (thousands of persons, total population on 1 July)
population.reference_note: WPP 2024 estimates run to 2023; 2026 values are medium-variant projections for 1 July 2026 (the same reference v0.1 used)
population.conversion: population = TPopulation1July x 1000 (exact; every value has at most 3 decimals)
population.changes: 26 rows selected (Time=2026, Medium; the basket economies and the euro-area members); thousands converted to persons; no other modification
population.interim_update: The WPP 2024 interim update released on 19 January 2026 revises Togo only; none of the locations used here changed

euro_area.definition: sum of the 21 euro-area member states
euro_area.accession_note: Bulgaria joined the euro area on 2026-01-01 at the irrevocably fixed rate BGN 1.95583 = EUR 1 (https://www.ecb.europa.eu/euro/changeover/bulgaria/html/index.en.html). Both FX dates fall after accession, so Bulgaria's population is valued at the EUR rate on both legs.

fx.source: European Central Bank, euro foreign exchange reference rates (units of currency per 1 EUR)
fx.conversion: usd_per_unit(C) = (USD per EUR) / (C per EUR); USD=1; EUR=(USD per EUR)

reasons.detail: v0.1 counts 20 euro-area member states; Bulgaria joined the euro area on 2026-01-01, so on both FX dates (2026-01-09, 2026-05-15) it had 21 members
v0.1 took the UN WPP 2024 figures from Worldometer's republication; this vintage reads the UN Population Division's own file
2 of v0.1's 25 populations differ from the UN file: Greece 9897115 (v0.1) vs 9897116 (UN); Slovenia 2114573 (v0.1) vs 2114574 (UN)
